organizations.blurb: Cooks and shares free vegan meals in San Francisco through volunteer-run weekly crews. New volunteers contact the crew for the day they want and then help cook, share, or clean up.

organizations.name: Stern Grove Festival
organizations.blurb: Produces free summer concert days at Stern Grove. Seasonal volunteers sign up for released shifts and help the concert day work for the public.

organizations.name: Tenderloin Community Benefit District
organizations.blurb: Works with residents and partners on cleaner, safer Tenderloin public space. Safe Passage volunteers stand corner shifts that support students, elders, residents, and visitors.

organizations.name: The Food Pantry
organizations.blurb: Runs a volunteer-powered Saturday food pantry at St. Gregory of Nyssa. New volunteers contact the pantry first, then help set up, share groceries, and close down.

organizations.name: Zooniverse
organizations.blurb: Turns small remote observations into help for real research projects. Volunteers choose a project, review one image or item, and mark what they observe.
